 class TodoStore:

+    def _load(self):
+        if os.path.exists(self.path):
+            try:
+                with open(self.path, "r") as f:
+                    data = json.load(f)
+                self.todos = {int(k): v for k, v in data.get("todos", {}).items()}
+                self._next_id = data.get("next_id", max(self.todos, default=0) + 1)
+            except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
+                self.todos = {}
+                self._next_id = 1
+
+    def _save(self):
+        with open(self.path, "w") as f:
+            json.dump({"todos": {str(k): v for k, v in self.todos.items()},
+                       "next_id": self._next_id}, f, indent=2)
+
+    def add(self, title, tags=None):
+        todo = {
+            "id": self._next_id,
+            "title": title,
+            "tags": list(tags or []),
+            "completed": False,
+        }
+        self.todos[self._next_id] = todo
+        self._next_id += 1
+        self._save()
+        return todo
